title: Manage Clients & Ad Campaigns with Manager Accounts – Google Ads

facts.fact: Google's page states that one email address can be used to manage up to 20 Google Ads accounts under a manager account.
facts.unit: Google Ads accounts per email address
facts.quote: You can use the same email address for up to 20 Google Ads accounts.

facts.fact: Google's page states that the name given to a manager account is the name clients will see in their client account.
facts.quote: This is the name that your clients will see in their client account.

facts.fact: Google's page states that a manager account can be used to manage your own Google Ads accounts or other people's accounts with their permission.
facts.quote: You can use a manager account to manage your own Google Ads accounts, or to manage other people’s accounts with their permission.

facts.fact: Google's page states that users can create multiple campaigns within the same Google Ads account without creating a new account.
facts.quote: You can create multiple campaigns in the same account without creating a new account.

facts.fact: Google's page states that manager account access can be shared with other managers, and the level of access can be controlled, with access levels including Administrative and Standard.
facts.quote: Share access with other managers, grant new access and control the level of access in case someone’s role changes.

facts.fact: Google's page states that managers can use labels, automated rules, alerts, and email notifications to organise and monitor linked accounts.
facts.quote: Use labels to organise accounts, create automated rules, set alerts and get email notifications.
